page.notes: The Hebrew is printed with vowel points that are small and partly smudged; vowel signs in the Hebrew words are copied as far as they can be seen and may be imperfect. Forms such as ראשה and ראשך in the paupertas entry and the vowels of למך and מראשיתיכם are doubtful. The dictionary entries are short lines in the print, copied here as paragraphs. The digitiser's mark at the foot and the page edges are left out.
